description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Zed's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] against targets below 50% '''maximum''' health are empowered to deal 5% / 7.5% / 10% (based on level) of the target's '''maximum''' health as '''bonus''' magic damage.
description.text: Innate: Zed's basic attacks on-hit against targets below 50% maximum health are empowered to deal 5% / 7.5% / 10% (based on level) of the target's maximum health as bonus magic damage.

description2.raw: Against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], ''Contempt for the Weak'' deals 75% damage and is capped at 175.
description2.text: Against monsters, Contempt for the Weak deals 75% damage and is capped at 175.

description3.raw: ''Contempt for the Weak'' cannot occur on the same [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] more than once every few seconds.
description3.text: Contempt for the Weak cannot occur on the same champion more than once every few seconds.

notes.raw: * The enhanced attack applies other [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] as normal (the bonus damage cannot). * ''Contempt for the Weak'' is not consumed when [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|missed]], but it is consumed when [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]]. * ''Contempt for the Weak'' considers the target's health upon landing the attack, not when it's declared. ** If the target falls below the threshold while '''Zed''' is winding up the attack, ''Contempt for the Weak'' applies, and vice versa. * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]].
notes.text:
The enhanced attack applies other on-hit effects and can critically strike as normal (the bonus damage cannot).
Contempt for the Weak is not consumed when dodged or missed, but it is consumed when blocked.
Contempt for the Weak considers the target's health upon landing the attack, not when it's declared.
* If the target falls below the threshold while Zed is winding up the attack, Contempt for the Weak applies, and vice versa.
The empowered attack will not trigger against structures.
